measure.measure_definition: Occurrence: participants with improvement of target organ damage (composite primary endpoint) from randomisation to last follow-up; Participants; Target organ damage reassessed at months 3, 6, 9, and 12. baPWV measured with Omron Vascular Profiler-1000/2000; urinary ACR measured in mid-morning urine samples; electrocardiographic left ventricular hypertrophy assessed by Sokolow-Lyon index or Cornell product. Composite endpoint assessed from randomisation to last follow-up.; Improvement defined as one or more of: baPWV decrease by ≥20% or to <1400 cm/s; ACR reduction by ≥20% or to <3.5 mg/mmol in women and <2.5 mg/mmol in men; or normalisation of Sokolow-Lyon index or Cornell product, over the 48-week follow-up. Primary ITT analysis included all randomised patients; missing values handled by multiple imputation in the primary ITT analysis.
measure.measure_name: Improvement of target organ damage (composite primary endpoint)

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: brachial-ankle pulse wave velocity (baPWV); Participants; baPWV measured after at least 5 minutes of supine rest using the Omron Vascular Profiler-1000/2000; left- and right-sided baPWV averaged. Assessed before treatment and at follow-up.; Continuous baPWV in cm/s. A baPWV of ≥1400 cm/s was a sign of arterial stiffening used for eligibility.

Measured value: urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR); Participants; ACR measured in two mid-morning urine samples collected on different days. Table 3 presents baseline ACR as geometric mean (IQR). ACR expressed in mg/mmol.; Continuous ACR in mg/mmol. Microalbuminuria threshold was ACR ≥3.5 mg/mmol in women and ≥2.5 mg/mmol in men.

population.intervention: Allisartan isoproxil; amlodipine could be added if ambulatory blood pressure remained uncontrolled.
population.intervention_regimen: Allisartan 80 mg/day initially; allisartan 160 mg/day from month 2 if ambulatory blood pressure remained uncontrolled; amlodipine 2.5 mg/day added at month 4 if still uncontrolled.; Once daily; planned titration at month 2 and month 4; 12-month treatment period.
population.population_definition: Randomised to active antihypertensive treatment; all randomised patients included in the intention-to-treat analysis.; Adults aged 30–70 years with masked hypertension confirmed at two screening visits 1 month apart (office BP <140/<90 mm Hg and 24-h, daytime or nighttime ambulatory BP ≥130/≥80, ≥135/≥85, or ≥120/≥70 mm Hg), at least one sign of target organ damage (electrocardiographic left ventricular hypertrophy, baPWV ≥1400 cm/s, or urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio ≥3.5 mg/mmol in women and ≥2.5 mg/mmol in men), untreated or off antihypertensive treatment for at least 2 weeks; randomised 1:1 and included in the intention-to-treat analysis.
population.population_time_frame: Recruited/randomised between February 14, 2017 and October 31, 2020; follow-up to 48 weeks/1 year.

population.intervention: Matching placebo for allisartan and amlodipine.
population.intervention_regimen: Matching placebo tablets corresponding to allisartan 80 mg, allisartan 160 mg, and amlodipine 2.5 mg.; Once daily; matching placebo titration mirrored active treatment at month 2 and month 4; 12-month treatment period.
